scientific_integrity: Exact Gaussian-integer determinant norms prove every-prime stability; explicit finite-field incidence and polynomial factorization prove the exceptional cases. Independent audit has not been performed.

title: Exact odd-prime degeneration of Edge’s twelve hyperflex tangents
